approvalTitle: Approve tasks for obsidian-sra-ui-parity (Full SRA Web UI parity inside Obsidian)
content:
# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Create shared UI core skeleton + transport interface
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/transport/SraTransport.ts`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/SraWorkbenchApp.tsx`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/index.ts`
  - Define `SraTransport` (HTTP + SSE + uploads + capabilities flags) and a minimal React root component API (`SraWorkbenchApp`).
  - Purpose: Establish a single reusable UI core that can be hosted by both Web and Obsidian.
  - _Leverage: `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/App.tsx`, `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/app/useAppController.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 1_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Frontend Architect (React + TypeScript) | Task: Create a shared UI core skeleton and `SraTransport` interface under `scientific-research-assistant/ui/` so the same React app can run in both Web and Obsidian hosts | Restrictions: Additive only (do not break existing Web UI); do not introduce port :5000 in docs/examples; keep shared code host-agnostic (no direct `obsidian` imports) | _Leverage: Current Web UI `App.tsx` + `useAppController.ts` as the feature baseline | _Requirements: Requirement 1 | Success: Shared UI core compiles as pure TS/React sources and defines clear transport/capabilities contracts | Process: Mark this task as [-] before coding, log implementation with log-implementation (artifacts required), then mark as [x]_

- [ ] 2. Implement WebTransport (fetch + EventSource) for shared UI
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/transport/WebTransport.ts`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/vite.config.ts`
  - Implement a `WebTransport` that satisfies `SraTransport` using relative `/api/*` paths and `EventSource` for SSE, preserving current Vite proxy behavior.
  - Purpose: Keep Web UI working while enabling shared UI core to depend on a stable transport abstraction.
  - _Leverage: `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/lib/agui-sdk.ts`, `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/app/useAppController.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 1, 2, 3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Web Platform Engineer | Task: Create a `WebTransport` implementation for `SraTransport` using fetch and EventSource, keeping existing Vite proxy behavior intact | Restrictions: Do not change backend; Web dev server must remain on :5173 and backend proxy default :5678; no :5000 examples | _Leverage: existing `AgUiClient` shim or equivalent EventSource parsing | _Requirements: Requirement 1, Requirement 2, Requirement 3 | Success: Web transport can drive sessions + SSE without regressions in the existing web UI | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 3. Implement ObsidianTransport (requestUrl + Node SSE) for shared UI
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/obsidian-plugin/src/transport/ObsidianTransport.ts`
  - Implement `ObsidianTransport` backed by `requestUrl` and existing `SraSseClient`, plus uploads via existing multipart builder.
  - Purpose: Provide a CORS-proof transport for Obsidian Desktop that matches shared UI expectations.
  - _Leverage: `scientific-research-assistant/obsidian-plugin/src/api/SraApiClient.ts`, `scientific-research-assistant/obsidian-plugin/src/sse/SraSseClient.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 1, 2, 3, 4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Obsidian Integration Engineer | Task: Implement `ObsidianTransport` that satisfies `SraTransport` using Obsidian `requestUrl` for HTTP and Node SSE for AG-UI events; support uploads and expose capability flags (local-only features) | Restrictions: No direct `fetch("/api")` usage in Obsidian; avoid CORS; do not store API keys in plugin settings; keep code < 800 lines/file | _Leverage: reuse existing `SraApiClient` + `SraSseClient` + multipart helper | _Requirements: Requirement 1, Requirement 2, Requirement 3, Requirement 4 | Success: Obsidian transport can create/list sessions, send input, connect SSE, and upload attachments successfully | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 4. Move controller logic into shared UI core (transport-driven) with wrappers
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/controller/useWorkbenchController.ts`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/app/useAppController.ts`
  - Create a shared controller hook that accepts `transport` + `capabilities` and produces the same state/actions as current Web UI, then make Web `useAppController` a thin wrapper that wires `WebTransport`.
  - Purpose: One canonical controller drives both Web and Obsidian UIs.
  - _Leverage: `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/app/useAppController.ts` (existing baseline behavior)_
  - _Requirements: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: React State/Architecture Engineer | Task: Refactor the existing controller into a shared, transport-driven hook so Web and Obsidian share identical session/chat/panel behavior; keep Web UI behavior unchanged | Restrictions: Do not change backend; avoid breaking Web UI; keep files < 800 lines by extracting helpers if needed; do not introduce any port 5000 references | _Leverage: existing `useAppController` behavior as truth; keep the same outward controller API used by UI components | _Requirements: Requirement 2, Requirement 3, Requirement 4, Requirement 5, Requirement 6, Requirement 7, Requirement 9, Requirement 10 | Success: Web UI still works, but its controller now delegates to shared controller using `WebTransport` | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 5. Port Web UI root to shared `SraWorkbenchApp` and keep Web host working
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/SraWorkbenchApp.tsx` (expand)
    - `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/App.tsx`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/main.tsx`
  - Move the core layout/navigation (chat + panels + files/dag views) into shared app component; make Web host mount it with `WebTransport`.
  - Purpose: Shared UI core becomes the single source-of-truth for the full workbench UI.
  - _Leverage: `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/App.tsx` (existing UI layout)_
  - _Requirements: 1, 2, 3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: React UI Engineer | Task: Port the existing Web UI root into `SraWorkbenchApp` and adapt the Web host to render it with `WebTransport`, preserving existing routes/query behavior | Restrictions: Web UI must remain usable; avoid breaking CSS; no port 5000 references; keep shared app host-agnostic | _Leverage: existing `App.tsx` as baseline; reuse existing panels/components with minimal churn | _Requirements: Requirement 1, Requirement 2, Requirement 3 | Success: `frontend` still builds and runs, now using shared `SraWorkbenchApp` | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 6. Add React host view inside Obsidian plugin (mount shared UI)
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/obsidian-plugin/src/ui/WorkbenchView.tsx`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/obsidian-plugin/src/main.ts`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/obsidian-plugin/package.json`
  - Add React dependencies and mount `SraWorkbenchApp` into an Obsidian `ItemView`, wiring `ObsidianTransport` and existing plugin settings (`baseUrl`, `vaultRoot`).
  - Purpose: Obsidian becomes a first-class host for the full SRA UI.
  - _Leverage: existing plugin view patterns, existing settings (`src/settings.ts`)_
  - _Requirements: 1, 2, 3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Obsidian Plugin UI Engineer (React) | Task: Create a React-mounted Obsidian view that renders the shared `SraWorkbenchApp` with `ObsidianTransport`; add necessary dependencies and commands to open it | Restrictions: Additive only; do not break existing plugin settings; keep plugin desktop-only; do not store API keys; do not use port :5000 | _Leverage: `obsidian-plugin` existing settings + transport clients | _Requirements: Requirement 1, Requirement 2, Requirement 3 | Success: Obsidian loads the plugin and the SRA workbench renders inside a sidebar view | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 7. Make Tailwind-based styling work in Obsidian (styles.css pipeline)
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/obsidian-plugin/tailwind.config.cjs`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/obsidian-plugin/styles.css`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/obsidian-plugin/package.json`
  - Add a minimal Tailwind build pipeline that produces `styles.css` for Obsidian plugin, scanning both shared UI and plugin host sources.
  - Purpose: Achieve near-identical look & feel to the Web UI.
  - _Leverage: `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/index.css`, `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/tailwind.config.*` (if exists)_
  - _Requirements: 1 (UX parity), NFR Performance/Usability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Frontend Tooling Engineer | Task: Add Tailwind CSS build for the Obsidian plugin producing `styles.css` so the shared React UI looks the same as the web app | Restrictions: Do not affect the web build; keep dependencies minimal; ensure content globs include shared UI sources; do not reference port 5000 | _Leverage: existing web Tailwind entry CSS and class usage | _Requirements: Requirement 1; NFR Usability | Success: Obsidian plugin renders with correct Tailwind styling (no “unstyled HTML”) | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 8. Implement Files page parity in Obsidian with local-only gating
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/pages/FilesPage.tsx`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/pages/FilesPage.tsx`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/transport/SraTransport.ts` (capability flag if needed)
  - Refactor Files page to use `transport` instead of direct `fetch`, and hide/disable when `capabilities.filesApi=false`.
  - Purpose: Files manager works in Obsidian when sidecar is local, and degrades safely for remote baseUrl.
  - _Leverage: existing `frontend/src/pages/FilesPage.tsx`, backend file endpoints in `ResearchSessionsApi`_
  - _Requirements: 8_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Full-stack UI Engineer | Task: Make Files page use the new transport and support local-only capability gating; keep the same UX (tree, editor, save) | Restrictions: Do not allow path traversal; ensure remote mode clearly disables local-only file APIs; do not break web UI routing | _Leverage: existing FilesPage + backend `/api/sessions/{id}/files/*` | _Requirements: Requirement 8 | Success: Files page works on local sidecar in Obsidian and remains functional in Web; remote mode disables it gracefully | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 9. Implement API key / LLM provider modal parity in Obsidian with safety gating
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/panels/ApiKeyModal.tsx`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/panels/ApiKeyModal.tsx`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/transport/SraTransport.ts` (capability flag if needed)
  - Refactor API key modal to use `transport` calls for `/api/llm/*` and `/api/secrets/*`, and disable key-reveal in remote mode.
  - Purpose: Obsidian can configure providers/models/test keys without storing them in plugin settings.
  - _Leverage: existing `frontend/src/panels/ApiKeyModal.tsx`, backend `Infrastructure/LlmSecretsApi.cs`_
  - _Requirements: 9_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Security-minded UI Engineer | Task: Port ApiKeyModal into shared UI, switching all network calls to transport and enforcing capability gating for sensitive operations (reveal key only on loopback) | Restrictions: Never store keys in plugin settings; do not break existing secrets endpoints; remote baseUrl must default to safer UX | _Leverage: existing ApiKeyModal behavior; LlmSecretsApi endpoints | _Requirements: Requirement 9 | Success: Users can configure providers and test/model list in Obsidian; key reveal is safely gated | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 10. Port remaining panels to shared UI (Composer, Goals, Brief, DAG, Trace, Delivery, Compute)
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/panels/*.tsx` (port each panel)
    - `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/panels/*.tsx` (convert to re-export stubs or remove usage)
  - Move panel implementations into shared UI and refactor them to use transport/controller props rather than direct `fetch`.
  - Purpose: Full panel parity in Obsidian without duplicating UI logic.
  - _Leverage: existing `frontend/src/panels/*` and corresponding backend endpoints_
  - _Requirements: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: React Component Engineer | Task: Port each remaining panel into shared UI core and replace direct fetch/EventSource assumptions with transport-driven calls, keeping existing UX and behavior | Restrictions: Keep each file < 800 lines; do not break web app; maintain feature parity; no port 5000 examples | _Leverage: existing panel components and backend endpoints list in `ResearchSessionsApi.cs` | _Requirements: Requirement 3, Requirement 4, Requirement 5, Requirement 6, Requirement 7 | Success: All panels render and operate in both Web and Obsidian hosts | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 11. Implement skills sync + tools/workspace UX parity in shared controller
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/controller/useWorkbenchController.ts`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/ui/src/transport/SraTransport.ts`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/frontend/src/app/skillsSync.ts` (re-export or deprecate as needed)
  - Ensure shared controller supports `/api/skills/sync` and `/api/skills/sync/status` polling + logs, and tools/workspace snapshot refresh flows.
  - Purpose: Obsidian host can fully drive skills sync + tools/workspace without relying on Web-only code.
  - _Leverage: existing `frontend/src/app/skillsSync.ts`, backend `/api/skills/*` endpoints_
  - _Requirements: 5, 6, 10_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Frontend State Engineer | Task: Port skills sync orchestration and tools/workspace refresh logic into the shared controller using the transport interface | Restrictions: Best-effort (failures must not break runs); keep controller modular; do not break web UI | _Leverage: existing skillsSync implementation and backend endpoints | _Requirements: Requirement 5, Requirement 6, Requirement 10 | Success: Skills sync works identically in Obsidian and Web, with status + logs and no UI freezes | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_

- [ ] 12. Update architecture docs to reflect shared UI core and dual hosts
  - Files:
    - `scientific-research-assistant/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
    - `scientific-research-assistant/docs/OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN.md`
  - Document the new shared UI core folder, transport abstraction, and how Web/Obsidian hosts wire it.
  - Purpose: Prevent future duplication and keep architecture memory consistent (required for architecture-level changes).
  - _Leverage: `.spec-workflow/steering/structure.md`, current SRA docs_
  - _Requirements: NFR Code Architecture/Modularity, Usability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec obsidian-sra-ui-parity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Documentation Engineer | Task: Update SRA architecture docs to reflect shared UI core and Obsidian/Web host responsibilities, including folder tree and key integration points | Restrictions: Be concise and precise; do not mention port 5000; keep docs aligned with actual code | _Leverage: existing ARCHITECTURE.md and new shared UI design | _Requirements: NFR Code Architecture/Modularity; NFR Usability | Success: Docs clearly explain how to develop/run both hosts and where shared code lives | Process: Mark [-] → implement → log-implementation → mark [x]_
